name: Moltin
long_description:
At Moltin, we believe that brand experiences should never be obscured by technology and that commerce development should be simple, lightweight and fun. 

Moltin is an API-first digital commerce solution that enables retailers to build distinctive shopping experiences and embed them into any consumer touchpoint. It combines an extremely flexible set of APIs, developer toolkits, pre-built applications and cloud infrastructure to make commerce development simple, lightweight and fast. Moltin APIs are the simplest, most powerful in the industry. Retailers can test new channels quickly, scale into new markets, and keep pace with ever-evolving consumer trends. With Moltin, commerce flows seamlessly across any channel, device and experience. 

Moltin has a rapidly growing community of more than 17,000 developers around the world, pushing the boundaries of traditional commerce.
one_liner: eCommerce building blocks through simple APIs for websites & apps.…

founders.title: Founder/CIO
founders.founder_bio: YC W15 founder, previously co-founder of Moltin, a developer-first commerce platform acquired by Elastic Path. Since then I’ve worked across fintech and auctions, building internal tooling for major financial institutions and now serving as Director of Engineering for auctions at Sotheby’s.

founders.title: Founder/Vice President Customer Success
founders.founder_bio:
I'm an ecommerce expert with over a decade of experience. Currently working at Redbrain, where I lead strategic projects that help online stores grow. I co-founded Moltin, an ecommerce API in 2013, which was later acquired in 2019.

I run Retailerboost, a Shopify app that runs incremental Google shopping ad campaigns to boost sales for merchants in USA. We fund the ads upfront with our capital so zero risk for merchants. We've generated 155,000+ orders and $10+ million in revenue for merchants.
